lines.text: The LORD tells Moses that any Israelite or foreigner living in Israel who gives children to Molech must be stoned.
If the people hide their eyes and spare that man, the LORD sets His face against him and his family.
The LORD says to be holy, and whoever curses his brother or sister must be put to death.
The LORD says the land won't vomit Israel out, and Israel will inherit their land, flowing with wine and honey.
The LORD says He has set Israel apart to be His own, and mediums and spiritists must be stoned.
